result.false_positives:
HOW THE SITE SHOWS REASONS. Live master shows one reason per answer. web/assets/ui.js reveal() renders only fb.mistake, and server/drill.py, api_today.py and api_results.py take reasons[given]. A missed grid-in shows nothing on screen and is only filed (server/progress.py ~L275). The v2 rebuild on branch v2/f3, web/assets/question.js optionLines(), shows every option's reason by default (prefs.option_reasons=true; spec/rebuild-v2.md 'Every option explained'). There a grid-in still shows only 'Your answer X is what you get if you ...' for the one value that matched. So for multiple choice (MCQ), repeats will appear side by side once v2 ships. For grid-ins they never do.

424 of the 501 findings are fine, in three patterns:

(1) Grid-in repeats, 29 findings: nleq.absolute_equation 15, nleq.square_equation 8, prob.two_way.marginal 5, prob.two_way.conditional 1. A typed value matches one mistake, so two reasons are never shown together, and each text is true of each value: both roots are 'one solution', and each cell really is divided by its own row or column total. The 7 prob.two_way.grouped findings are also harmless as repeats, but their labels are wrong (see real).

(2) The filler label 'near-miss arithmetic slip', 5 findings not already listed as real: rtt.cofunction_angles 4 (the named roots must be whole numbers, so the pool runs short) and nleq.factored_equation seed 49 (roots -1, 1 and -5 collapse the pool). This is satbank.item._fillers' stand-in for an unnamed near-miss, and server/progress.py FILLER/UNNAMED files it as a slip, not a named trap. It is the fallback working as designed. The other 19 filler findings sit on degenerate draws, reported as real.

(3) Pick-one items with text or statement options, where the shared reason is true of every option it tags, 390 findings: tvdata.series_extreme 50 (every other year reads higher), tvdata.nonlinear_table 50 (checked 200 seeds: every wrong table rises by a constant step), tvdata.graph_statement 50, rtt.cofunction_match 50 (tan L and tan M), tvdata.interval_change 40 (the 'moves less than the answer's' repeats), esc.must_be_true 47 (each reason names the first numeral where that option leaves the truth, claims.py ~L302), le2.interpret_constant 25 (each option is one of the two terms), esc.conclusion 17, esc.generalize 20, sstat.margin_size 12 (the lower and higher percent options), sstat.interpret_percent 6, ovd.freq_choose 10 (checked: every 'tail to the left' option has mean < median), and lin.from_table's 13 seeds with x0 = 0 (they mirror official item 1.32). Side by side these read like College Board's own 'Choice A is incorrect because...'.

A site bug outside the bank matters here. On branch v2/f5, server/practice.py sends "filler": [not bool(reason) for reason in it.reasons]. That flags the key, never the filler text, so v2 would print 'Near-miss arithmetic slip' under each filler instead of the spec's 'a nearby value, not tied to a specific mistake'. The fix is [reason == progress.FILLER for reason in it.reasons].
